turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on there is and there are?
turns.tutor:
Look: There is a clock on the wall. It is one clock, so we say there is.
Rule: use there is for one thing and there are for more than one thing.
Right: There is a bird in the tree. Wrong: There are a bird in the tree.
Now you try. Write the missing words.
Complete: "___ three windows in my room."
